name: game-trend-site-builder
title_zh: 先试玩再动工的单个游戏官网生成器
tagline_zh: 给它一个游戏名或商店链接，它先去查实况、找能用的第三方试玩嵌入，确认玩得到才生成视觉、文案、SEO 和响应式页面。
tagline_en: Give it a game name or store URL, it verifies real gameplay and a working browser embed before writing visuals.
desc_en: Build a deployable, game-native, play-first SEO website from a game keyword or official game URL. Research the real game first, verify a working third-party browser embed when possible, then generate a visual system, page architecture, copy, SEO metadata, structured data, responsive UI, and QA plan tailored to that specific game.
why_zh: 别人按关键词堆模板，它按真实玩法定结构。先验证可玩性再动手，页面从第一屏就带游戏自己的气质。
why_en: Others template from keywords; it builds from verified gameplay. Playability first, so the page feels native to that game, not a.
limit_zh: 只服务单个游戏，不生成多游戏聚合站；试玩嵌入找不到或官方禁止第三方 iframe 时，它会降级为截图+预告片方案。
limit_en: Single-game sites only, no aggregators. If no legal third-party embed exists, it falls back to screenshots + trailer—no playable demo guaranteed.
title_en: Game-site builder that play-tests before it writes
